fixture_note: celebration_safety: the field package (kind 30079) as published when the window armed, built by beu/field_missions.card and package_manifest with the two additions (metadata.mechaJono.window, metadata.mechaJono.case and one `reports` entry). Every profile tag NavCom reads is unchanged. It carries `case` and its `reports` entry because, under ⟨WA D2⟩, the Case is taken as published by the time this night arms; before that they are absent and `reports` is []. No taking_part tag while the window is ahead or open ⟨WA D5⟩. The manifest is UNSIGNED: a signed release adds metadata.signature (ML-DSA-65) under the new key, and a verifier refuses this fixture as missing-manifest-signature until then. It is sent again at the same d when the anchor becomes actual (valid_until moves 7 minutes). The figures in `why` are real: FDNY's 44 against 11 is our count from FDNY's dispatch records (76xm-jjuj); 10 officers injured, a shooting and four stabbings or slashings are the NYPD's, as CBS News New York and Gothamist reported them. The night is hypothetical and INVENTED: Thu 10 Jun 2027, Finals Game 6 away, the Knicks 3–2 up, tip-off 8:30 pm Eastern (the 2026 Finals' tip-off by Wikipedia's 2026 NBA Finals page, assumed again), the anchor estimated as tip-off plus 2 h 35 min (docs/rlsh/02 section 4) and an INVENTED actual buzzer at 11:12 pm. The profile (lead 155 min, or 162 once the buzzer is actual; peak 75; half-life 60; end 300) is read by hand off doc 02 section 4's measured title night (FDNY EMS dispatch records, our count), rounded, not fitted. The score line and its numbers are doc 02 section 5.2's illustration on 2025–2026, scored after the fact (our count from FDNY's dispatch records, 76xm-jjuj); a real 2027 window carries what the pre-registered rule gives then. The city point is GeoNames 5128581 rounded to 0.01 degree.

provenance.real: the figures in `why` (our count from FDNY's dispatch records; the NYPD's, as reported); the safety rules; the objectives and effect lines (docs/rlsh/03 section 2); the score line
provenance.invented: the night, its times and its window, and the publication time
